decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 15020/TP/006 rev A, 007 rev B, 008 rev B, 009 rev C, 010 rev B, 012 rev A and 013 rev A received on 9 December 2015. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of development a management plan shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to include the following:
"	Details of facilities for the storage and disposal of waste
"	Servicing for the units
"	Measures to ensure the area will be clean and secure 
"	Opening hours of the site
The proposed scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved plan thereafter.
description: Erection of four new retail kiosks (Use Class A1) a new lift, toilet, sliding doors and other associated works.
